authenticated_creation_observed_after_vm.interpretation: The 64.0% denominator is new authenticated-creation mints with at least one accepted decoded trade (194/303), not all creations and not all 7,621 curves.

post_start_event_mints_without_authentic.interpretation: Creation capture is not a prerequisite for entry_tracking_ready. Pump-suffix fallback supplies token supply and decimals, while supported trade receipts can supply the remaining readiness fields. This cohort is not counted as authenticated new creations.

count_semantics.entry_tracking_ready: tracking_error is absent; token_supply_raw > 0; token_decimals is present; reserves_authoritative, fee_policy_known, and supported_sol_quote are true.
count_semantics.relationships: entry_tracking_ready and tracking_error are disjoint by predicate. missing_creation is an independent flag and overlaps the other groups. The 339 curves with no tracking_error but not entry-ready are outside both ready and error totals.

receipt_and_candidate_evidence.entry_gate: Source requires holder_ready or whitelist, entry_tracking_ready, screening-window eligibility, and an evaluated strategy trigger. SETUP_TRACKING_AUDIT rows are diagnostics and may repeat per mint; they are not buy signals. Circuit breakers were disabled in the checkpoint summary.
receipt_and_candidate_evidence.global_gap_note: The 475 state entries carrying unscoped receipt coverage gap are in the pre-VM/restored cohort. Current-VM unresolved rows had no global_coverage_gap flag. Source also has a separate greater-than-two-second stream-gap invalidation path; the decoded tape alone cannot verify that ingress condition.
receipt_and_candidate_evidence.observation_gap_limit_note: The persisted decoded observation tape is not the raw Yellowstone ingress stream, so its maximum gap cannot independently rule out every ingress gap over two seconds.

reserve_transition_example.balance_delta_check: r_sol before minus sell amount equals the decoded post r_sol (217171014).
reserve_transition_example.interpretation: Observed v_sol transition mismatch; plausible causes include event-layout/decoder interpretation, protocol virtual-reserve semantics, or a real transition discrepancy. The local tracker quarantined the curve on reserve transition gap/inconsistency.
reserve_transition_example.rpc_check: Read-only Shyft getTransaction confirmed the exact slot/signature, err=null, and token balances/logs consistent with the local tape. This does not establish a missing feed receipt.

scope: Read-only runtime coverage audit. No source, runtime, checkpoint, tape, or cash state was modified.
